summary: P0 Feature Complete: Sinks module with per-month evidence uploads is fully functional. All 14 features tested and verified - Backend APIs (CRUD), Evidence upload, file view/download, and Frontend UI all working correctly.

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement recommended but non-blocking
Console warning: HTML hydration error (span inside tr/tbody) - React development warning, does not affect functionality

details: Sinks page loads correctly
Table shows all expected columns: Facility, Period, Emissions Reduced, Description, Evidence, Actions
Dialog opens with Facility dropdown, Reporting Year dropdown, 12 monthly accordions, Description field, Cancel/Add buttons
Each month accordion expands to show: offset value input, evidence upload area
Evidence file list displays when files are uploaded
Creating sink with monthly values works correctly
Total is calculated correctly from sum of monthly values (25.5 + 30.0 = 55.50)
Evidence file upload works for each month
Files appear in evidence list with view/download/remove buttons
Toast notification: 'Evidence uploaded for January'
Evidence files can be removed from month's list
Remove button (X icon) successfully removes file from list
Editing sink properly restores form data
Monthly values and evidence files are preserved
Delete sink works correctly
Confirmation dialog appears, sink removed after confirmation
Period column displays 'Jan'2025' format correctly (not full date range)
Evidence column shows file count badge (e.g., '1') for sinks with evidence files
POST /api/sinks - Creates sink with monthly_data containing {value, evidence} per month
PUT /api/sinks/{id} - Updates sink properly with new monthly_data
GET /api/sinks - Returns all sinks with monthly_data structure
DELETE /api/sinks/{id} - Deletes sink correctly
POST /api/upload/evidence - Uploads file and returns file_id and url
Response: {file_id, filename, size, url: '/api/files/{id}'}
Supports PDF, images, Excel, CSV, Word files (max 10MB)
GET /api/files/{id}/view - Public endpoint for viewing images and PDFs
GET /api/files/{id}/download - Public endpoint for downloading any file type

critical_code_review_comments: Sinks.js is well-structured with proper state management for monthlyData
Evidence upload uses proper FormData with multipart/form-data
Backend SinkResponse model correctly has organization_id as Optional
monthly_data structure: { monthIndex: { value: string, evidence: [{name, url, file_id}] } } - handles legacy data
seed_data_creation: Test file created: test_sinks_evidence.py. Test sinks were created and cleaned up during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sinks module with per-month evidence uploads is fully functional.
